units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 6">Gen. R. s. 6</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 50:6">Ps. L, 6</cite>) <he>לעתיד … שמים מְתַנִּים וכ׳</he> in the future the heavens shall tell the righteousness which the Lord does to his world.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 277">Yalk. Jer. 277</cite> <he>והיה מְתַנֶּה נסים וכ׳</he> and he told the wonders that happened to him &c.; (<cite ref="Berakhot 13a:3">Ber. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>מספר</he>).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 109:11">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVIII, 14</cite> <he>לא לי לתַנּוֹת כל וכ׳</he> is it not my duty to tell all the wonders &c.?; a. e.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 8b:8">B. Bath. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>רשאין … להַתְנוֹת על וכ׳</he> the residents of a town have a right to stipulate measures, prices of food, and wages of laborers.

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 9:1">Keth. IX, 1</cite> <he>שה׳ על מה שכתוב וכ׳</he> because he made an agreement contrary to what is written in the Law; <he>וכל המַתְנֶה על וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="V00719"><he>תְּנַאי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eruvin 3:5">Erub. III, 5</cite> <he>מתנה אדם על ערובו וכ׳</he> a man may lay his ‘Erub (v. <cite ref="P00680"><he>עֵירוּב</he></cite>) on condition and say, if gentiles come &c.

<cite ref="Eruvin 36b:9">Ib. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>אין אדם מתנה על … כאחד</he> no man can lay down conditions for two alternatives together (so as to reserve to himself the choice in the event of both alternatives coming to pass); a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מוּתְנֶה</he>; pl. <he>מוּתְנִים</he>; <cite ref="M00703"><he>מוּתְנִין</he></cite>. Y. Keth. X, end, 34ᵃ; Y. B. Kam. IV, 4ᵇ top <he>שוורים כמ׳ הן</he> in the case of oxen (of several owners, consecutively gored by the same ox) it is as if an agreement had been made beforehand.
